messages:
sam: kicking off post-deploy smoke for release r32.1, canary at 10% in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. watching synth + kv probes.

deploy-bot: deploy r32.1 -> canary(10%) started. running synthetic probes: kv-synth ok, embed-synth failing in eu-west-1 (503). retrying probes...

nisha: seeing the 503s on the embed synth — are these model errors or upstream proxy timeouts?

leo: raw tail from proxy-pool-3: `ERROR upstream request failed: upstream timed out after 30s` and `queue_length=78` repeated. looks like backpressure on that pool.

sam: ok that's likely infra, not model. can we route canary eu traffic away from proxy-pool-3 while we triage? quick mitigation suggestion: enable fallback routing to smaller model-variant for eu canary only.

ci-bot: smoke_synth(eu-west-1) metrics: error_rate=12%, p95=2800ms, baseline_p95=500ms, window=3m.

nisha: routing fallback to small-quant would reduce proxy work but affects perf/quality. options: 1) temporary fallback for canary eu, 2) rollback canary to previous digest `sha256:abc1234`, 3) drain/replace proxy-pool-3 (slower).

leo: prefer option 1 for speed; limit scope to canary traffic only so production stays untouched. plan: enable routing rule scoped to tag `deploy:canary-r32.1` -> `model:embed-small-quant`.

sam: decision: HOLD progressive rollout at 10%. ENABLE eu canary routing fallback (scoped) now. monitor for 10 minutes. if p95 > 1s or error_rate > 5% after 10m, ROLLBACK canary to `sha256:abc1234`. create follow-up to replace proxy pool.

deploy-bot: APPLY: routing-fallback rule created and attached to canary traffic (eu-west-1). will run metric check in 5m. details: `route_id=rf-2026-03-21-01`

ci-bot: 5m-check: p95(eu) dropped to 900ms, error_rate down to 1.2%. alert: degraded->stabilized.

nisha: great — I'll add note to release notes: "temporary eu canary fallback to embed-small-quant due to proxy backlog; follow-up to investigate proxy-pool-3 queueing." also opening tracking issue: infra#778.

sam: assign follow-up: triage proxy queueing, add synthetic probe for proxy queue_length, add runbook step to reroute canary traffic in <5m.

leo: PR with routing change recorded in #5432. I'll follow up with a short postmortem once we have proxy logs. :thumbsup:

sam: final: keep rollout paused at 10% for 1h, then reassess. leaving this thread open until rollback window closes. thanks everyone.
